title: 伝説のお姫様『カワカミプリンセス』

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: "Do you know the princess named Kawakami Princess?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey, Kawakami. Let's do some partner runnin' today!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hey, I was supposed to be first! Don't you know how to wait your turn?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Now, now—calm down, you two. How about we all compete together in a scrimmage instead?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'll crush you both with my speed!

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: "As wild and unruly in life as she is on the track, the glow of her heart shines strong…"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh my! So we meet once again, my dear friend Sweep. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Don't talk like we're equals! I'm the star here, not you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: What?! How could you say something so mean?! The true star…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Is our friendship, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: "She always shows her opponents respect, even as she strives with all her might to overcome them."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Everyone, thank you so much for watching our races!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Braids
text_block_list.text: You were so awesome!

text_block_list.name: Suntanned Boy
text_block_list.text: Hey, keep talking like that, and she'll go soft! Princess, I know you can become even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Suntanned Boy
text_block_list.text: You're the one who keeps us going!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh my. Thank you for both your kind and strict words of encouragement. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But don't you worry. I'll never stop trying to get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: In order to continue being true to myself, and to keep shining like a dazzling princess…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'll always blaze my own path.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: "She is a princess who continually looks ahead—her silhouette a source of inspiration for the people."

text_block_list.name: Monitor
text_block_list.text: "The Legendary Princess: Kawakami Princess! Now on sale and available to rent!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: They put the film about me next to the Princess Fighter shelf…

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text: A lot of things have happened since that live broadcast… But I'm relieved we were finally able to release this film.

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text: I'm just sorry it's in the form of a documentary instead of a cartoon. I know you love Princess Fighter…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No, I'm truly grateful! I think this way…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It does a better job at conveying the message that I envisioned.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The request came to us just after we'd wrapped up Kawakami Princess's third year.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …A special about me?

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text: Yes. But it won't be broadcast on TV—we intend to release it to the retail market.

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text: We're thinking of coordinating with both the online content and film departments to make it available to buy, rent, or even stream.
choice_data_list: This seems like a pretty major project…

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text: Haha. It's rather paltry when you compare it to the things Kawakami Princess is trying to teach the next generation.

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text: I mean, she's trying to work alongside the younger students to build a new era.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Mommy, I wanna rent this one!

text_block_list.name: Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text: Hmm, this isn't a cartoon, you know. Those outfits are really cute, but it's probably too complicated for you. You'll fall asleep midway through it.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Nuh-uh! I can watch it!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: I mean, I'm a big girl now—huh?!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Kawakami… Princess?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hm? Yes, I'm Kawakami Princess…

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Really?! You're the real Kawakami Princess?! Wow!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Um, I wannna grow up to be just like you one day!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: I want to be an amazing princess, too!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes, and I'm sure you will be. You'll become your own ideal princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And one day, you'll meet a prince of your own, who believes in you and will walk that path alongside you.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: A prince?! Is that… someone like my daddy?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hehe, maybe so. Or maybe it's someone like your mommy. Or maybe they're not even a person at all.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But as long as you always put in the effort to achieve your dreams, I'm sure you'll get what you wish for and meet wonderful people along the way.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That's what happened to me. Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: See?! So all you have to do is walk down the path you believe in.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You're only at the very beginning of your princess path!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with those words, Kawakami Princess—or rather, the ultimate princess—treats the young girl to a truly radiant smile.
